//: BPX-1 flow configuration. Every difference from the Tiny Tapeout template default is listed, with its reason and evidence, in docs/area.md (spec AL-02).

33 ns = 30.3 MHz (owners, 27 Nov 2026; was 30 ns): the slow corner (ss, 100 C, 1.60 V) closes with margin with the perceptron sum and the leaky twin in the predict cycle, and the canaries get a lead of about 1 ns typical (docs/mosaic.md 7.5, step 5).
Hold margins halved and fan-out limit raised from 10 to 16: 4,300 um2 fewer repair buffers (trial B).
Synthesis may use drive-strength-1 gates (the PDK list minus its plain _1 logic gates and flop): 7,000 um2.
Place-and-route may not use the slow clkdlybuf4s25/s50 cells as fan-out buffers: 3 ns on the worst path.
The flow's constraints plus one false-path exception: the enable arc of the leaky twin's tri-state cells (reasons and measurements in bpx.sdc).

The delay cells of the write-pulse selector and of the canaries (instances u_dly, docs/mosaic.md 7.4, 7.5) are their delay, and the two ring oscillators (u_ro.u_ra, u_ro.u_rb, 7.7) must stay cell for cell identical: the resizer may not resize, remove or buffer them.
